name: Ghost Self-Hosted
description: Ghost Self-Hosted is the customer-operated distribution of Ghost's open-source publishing platform for websites, newsletters and memberships. Publishers use it to write, manage and distribute posts while retaining control of the application, database and infrastructure.
agentUseSummary: Connect one current public HTTPS Ghost installation with a dedicated Custom Integration Admin API key. Selected agents can use six fixed posts-only Admin API actions under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions; pages, members, commerce, newsletters, users, settings, themes, webhooks, raw APIs and private-network endpoints remain unavailable.

credentialRequirements.name: GHOST_SELF_HOSTED_INSTALLATION_URL
credentialRequirements.label: Ghost installation URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: The public HTTPS root of one current customer-operated Ghost installation, including any configured subdirectory. Private addresses, custom ports, redirects and embedded credentials are rejected.

credentialRequirements.name: GHOST_SELF_HOSTED_ADMIN_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Ghost Admin API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: A dedicated Custom Integration Admin API key. Railway uses it only to sign short-lived request-local JWTs for the fixed posts surface.

capabilities.label: Read posts
capabilities.description: List bounded post summaries and read one exact post, including draft content.

capabilities.label: Write drafts
capabilities.description: Create one draft or update the title and HTML of one exact post.

capabilities.label: Publish and delete
capabilities.description: Publish, unpublish or permanently delete one exact post.

approvalRequired.label: List posts
approvalRequired.description: List at most twenty bounded post summaries, including drafts.

approvalRequired.label: Read post
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact post and at most 50,000 characters of HTML.

approvalRequired.label: Create draft
approvalRequired.description: Create one unpublished draft from bounded title and HTML.

approvalRequired.label: Update post
approvalRequired.description: Update the title or HTML of one exact post with collision detection.

approvalRequired.label: Publish or unpublish post
approvalRequired.description: Set one exact post to published or draft with collision detection.

blocked.label: Manage pages or tags
blocked.description: Pages, tags, authors and navigation are unavailable in this posts-only V1.

blocked.label: Manage members or commerce
blocked.description: Members, tiers, offers, subscriptions, newsletters and billing are unavailable.

blocked.label: Administer Ghost
blocked.description: Users, settings, themes, images, webhooks, integrations, keys and site administration are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run arbitrary Admin API calls
blocked.description: Agents cannot choose paths, query parameters, fields, filters, ordering, pages, authors, tags, visibility or arbitrary request bodies.

blocked.label: Reach private infrastructure
blocked.description: Private, local, reserved, link-local, non-HTTPS and redirecting endpoints are unavailable; Relay opens no tunnel and keeps the web backend on Railway.

blocked.label: Bulk export content
blocked.description: Twenty-row lists, one exact post, 50,000-character HTML and 256 KiB responses are the maximum supported surface.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All private reads and content mutations require approval. Exact installation binding, fixed posts-only routes, collision checks, bounds and audits always apply.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All six selected posts actions run without Relay per-action approval; exact authority, fixed routes, collision checks, bounds, redaction and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway signs short-lived Ghost integration JWTs and executes six fixed posts-only Admin API actions against the exact public HTTPS installation with collision checks, bounds and redaction.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer administrator must create a dedicated Custom Integration in Ghost Admin and capture its Admin API key through the separate provider-console acceptance task.
providerSetup.nextAction: Operate and secure a current Ghost release at a public HTTPS URL, create a dedicated Custom Integration, capture its Admin API key only in the provider-console acceptance task, and enter the URL and key in Relay. Keep Ghost and MySQL patched, backed up and isolated; never expose MySQL publicly.

evidence.supports: Ghost documents customer-operated installation and infrastructure requirements for the open-source publishing platform.
The official Admin API overview documents the /ghost/api/admin base, Custom Integration keys, fixed integration permissions, Ghost JWT authentication and stable posts endpoints.
The official posts reference documents browse, exact read, add, edit and delete routes plus wrapped resources and bounded pagination controls.
Ghost requires updated_at for edit collision detection and recommends fetching the latest post before amendment.
Ghost documents exact-ID permanent post deletion with an empty successful response.
